messages:
deploybot: :rotating_light: Auto-hold executed on release slot 3825 — pausing rollout due to spike of 503s in eu-region (alert INC-2026). Reason: upstream ingress flapping exceeding safety threshold. Slot pinned to v2026.3 until investigation completes.

sara: Ack. I'm looking at the gateway graphs now — saw the 503s start ~3m before the hold.

mike: Do we have any error traces? Could be a config rollout that landed in front of this release.

oncall_amy: I can tail the LB logs and check backend health. If it's external, we should avoid rolling back app versions.

jordan: Quick note: this slot had the db-schema migration flagged as deferred, so no infra changes in this rollout.

ops_lead: If infra stable, plan is: 1) validate ingress/backends, 2) if no external cause -> rollback slot 3825, 3) otherwise keep pinned and reschedule. Need ops signoff before rollback.

sara: Found intermittent 502->503 chain from CDN edge -> origin. Pinging CDN team, filing ticket.

deploybot: Helpful commands:
```
# to inspect slot details
/deploy status 3825
# to pin/unpin
/deploy pin 3825 v2026.3
/deploy schedule 3825 --window "2024-11-01T02:00Z/2024-11-01T04:00Z"
```

oncall_amy: CDN says they did a config push at ~08:58 that caused a short TTL mismatch. They already rolled that back. Metrics look like they're trending down but still noisy.

mike: Given CDN rollback, suggest holding for 30m to ensure stability then soft resume canary to 5%. If flake returns, escalate to full rollback.

ops_lead: Agreed. Temporary plan: keep slot pinned to v2026.3, open a 30m observation window, then resume with canary 5% -> 25% if OK. If we see >0.5% 503s in next 30m, rollback.

jordan: I'll prepare release-note blurb marking a paused deploy and rationale for release docs and customer comms.

sara: FYI telemetry: prefix cache evictions also rose during the spike, might be correlated. Logging more detailed traces now.

deploybot: Hold annotated: reason="ingress-503s (CDN config)"; pinned_version="v2026.3"; observation_window="30m". Next action window scheduled: 1702501801 (2024-11-01T02:00Z).

ops_lead: I'll create the follow-up checklist in the release thread and update the deploy calendar. If all green at observation end, we do controlled resume and add a postmortem note to release notes. If not, rollback then coordinate backfill/reschedule for the next safe window.

oncall_amy: On standby for rollback steps if needed. Please @ops_lead when ready to action. :thumbsup:

mike: Thanks all — keeping this pinned until CDN confirms full recovery.

jordan: Draft release note snippet: "Deployment paused due to upstream ingress instability (CDN config incident). Deployment will resume after verification; customers may see delayed feature availability."

sara: CDN just confirmed full rollback and green check on their end. Still watching for residuals.

ops_lead: Noted. We'll reassess at observation window end (1702501801). If stable, schedule a phased resume and update the ticket.
